% The LaTeX half of webpage.tex. The webpage class is structurally an
% article whose headings carry no numbers and whose pages carry none; this
% is an article declaring those two, so what differs is the classes' own
% defaults.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fontspec}
\setmainfont{OpenSans-Regular.ttf}[Path=../corpus/fonts/, BoldFont=OpenSans-Bold.ttf, ItalicFont=OpenSans-Italic.ttf, BoldItalicFont=OpenSans-BoldItalic.ttf]
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
Alder is the page's first paragraph.

Birch is its second paragraph.

\section*{Cedar heading}
Dogwood sits under the heading.
\end{document}
